answer_1.quote: In this work we wish to leverage such models for product reviews summarization, aiming to generally improve the quality of generated summaries

answer_2.quote: we use the standard ROUGE-1/2/L metrics

answer_3.quote: we train a classifier that receives two summaries as input and decides whether the first summary is more coherent than the second or the opposite

answer_4.quote: we conducted a crowdsourced human evaluation task
answer_4.guideline: We used Best-Worst Scaling to compute each system's score as the difference between the percentage of times it was selected as best, and the percentage of times it was selected as worst
